whether Flux Operator (controlplaneio-fluxcd/flux-operator) is used to deploy the Flux controllers, in which case the migration is not required

consequence.statement: The `flux migrate` command must be run on clusters before upgrading to Flux 2.7.0 (unless Flux Operator deploys the Flux controllers), because the deprecated v1beta1 and v2beta1 Flux APIs have been removed from the CRDs.
consequence.remediation: Run `flux migrate` on the cluster(s) before upgrading to Flux 2.7.0; environments that deploy the Flux controllers with Flux Operator are exempt. See the Flux v2.7 upgrade guide (https://fluxcd.io/blog/2025/09/flux-v2.7.0/#upgrade-procedure).

assertion.statement: In Flux 2.7.0 the deprecated v1beta1 and v2beta1 Flux APIs have been removed from the CRDs, and unless the Flux controllers are deployed with Flux Operator, the `flux migrate` command must be run on clusters before upgrading.
